Maya (AE): CorVest vendor team wants concrete evidence for the POC: console admin changes, API key rotation, emergency access events, and verifiable immutability for 12 months. They prefer Splunk HEC. Can we produce an evidence packet + signed manifest in 48h?

Jon (SE): Yes. We'll create a compact bundle: audit.jsonl (examples of admin.role.grant, api_key.rotate, emergency.access.grant, export.start/export.complete), manifest.sha256, PGP-signed manifest, Splunk HEC + syslog-TLS runbook, and an attestation PDF. Hosted retention is 90d by default so export->customer S3 with object-lock=COMPLIANCE + customer KMS is the recommended approach to meet 12mo.

Priya (Security): Redaction policy: default mask of email local-parts and ids; we'll include README_redaction.md with before/after samples. We'll sign the manifest with our security PGP key and include fingerprint in the attestation. Attestation will state scope (hosted tenant ID), date range, fields redacted, and contact security@redwood.com.

Hannah (CorVest Sec): Also request that the export records operator + job_id and that the manifest includes per-file SHA256. We need clear verification steps for our vendor-risk team.

Jon (SE): Will include operator/job_id in export events. Sample audit lines we'll include in bundle (redacted where noted):

{"ts":"2026-11-10T08:12:01Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-f9d2","range":"2026-11-01..2026-11-10"}
{"ts":"2026-11-10T08:13:22Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"api_key.rotate","target":"svc-bridge","ip":"198.51.100.45","result":"success"}
{"ts":"2026-11-10T08:14:10Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"admin.role.grant","target":"team-security","reason":"approved-change"}
{"ts":"2026-11-10T08:15:30Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.complete","job_id":"job-f9d2","artifact":"bundle-20261110.zip"}

Jon (SE): Splunk HEC minimal test snippet for runbook (to paste into customer docs):

curl -sS https://splunk.corvest.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2026-11-10T08:13:22Z","actor":"admin@corvest.com","action":"api_key.rotate","resource":"svc-bridge"}}'

Priya (Security): Example manifest.sha256 entries we'll supply (one line per file):

# manifest.sha256
bundle-20261110-part1.jsonl  e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
bundle-20261110-part2.jsonl  7c4a8d09ca3762af61e59520943dc26494f8941b

Priya (Security): Verification steps we'll include in runbook: 1) download bundle into directory 2) run `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256` 3) verify PGP signature: `gpg --verify manifest.sha256.sig manifest.sha256` 4) confirm S3 object-lock COMPLIANCE is enabled on the bucket (customer control). We'll include the PGP fingerprint and the attestation.pdf referencing AWS S3 COMPLIANCE semantics vs GOVERNANCE.

Hannah (CorVest Sec): Good. Please make the attestation explicit about what is redacted and include the operator job-id lines so we can trace chain-of-custody. Also include an example CLI snippet to show how we can verify immutability on our side.

Jon (SE): We'll put a short chain-of-custody blurb in README: export records operator+job_id, bundles have manifest.sha256, we sign the manifest, and when the customer stores artifacts in object-lock COMPLIANCE the files cannot be modified or deleted for the retention window. We'll also include verification CLI and a small note on legal weight.

ExportBot: export job started for 1840123456 - collecting audit events (range: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-10) ETA ~55m :gear:

Maya (AE): I'll tell CorVest we'll deliver bundle + signed manifest + runbook within 48h and offer a short walkthrough.

ExportBot: export slice ready (1840123456/slice-2026-11-10.zip) - files: slice.jsonl (380KB), slice.sha256 - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1840123456/slice-2026-11-10.zip

Hannah (CorVest Sec): Received slice. I see api_key.rotate lines. Will run quick hash check and revert.

Priya (Security): Attestation draft: "Redwood Inference attests that the attached artifacts are exports from hosted tenant tn-AB12 covering 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-10. Fields marked REDACTED were masked per Redwood redaction policy v2.3. Manifest was signed by security@redwood.com (PGP fingerprint: 4E2F 9A1B 3C7D 5E6F 12AB 34CD 56EF 7890 AB12 3456)." We'll attach attestation.pdf and manifest.sha256.sig to the final bundle.

ExportBot: final bundle uploaded (1840123456/final-bundle-2026-11-10.zip) - files: audit.jsonl (1.6MB), manifest.sha256, manifest.sha256.sig, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1840123456/final-bundle-2026-11-10.zip

Hannah (CorVest Sec): Received final bundle and attestation. Will run verification steps and follow up if needed. Thanks for including operator/job_id for chain-of-custody.

Maya (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll book a short verification call with CorVest if they want a live walkthrough.
